hypothesis.statement: Building a 6-node time-delay-stability network (EEG delta/alpha/sigma + EOG/EMG/respiration) from one real overnight polysomnogram and splitting it by sleep stage, the network RECONFIGURES: it is most integrated in REM (most surrogate-significant links) and least in wake/light sleep, the EEG-delta rhythm is the persistent hub, and the link set turns over between wake and REM.

analysis_plan.dataset: Sleep-EDF Expanded (PhysioNet sleep-edfx), subject SC4001; 6 physiological node signals at 1 Hz over the ~6.7 h scored sleep period, with the hypnogram grouped Wake / Light / Deep / REM

decision.threshold: descriptive: the per-stage networks must DIFFER (density and link set change); REM the most integrated; the slow-wave EEG-delta rhythm the hub; only surrogate-significant links kept
